href=\\\"#designated_record_set\\\"><span style=\\\"color: #2980b9;\\\">Elation’s Designated Record Set</span></a><span style=\\\"color: #2980b9;\\\"> </span></u>\\n<ul><li><u><a href=\\\"#data\\\"><span style=\\\"color: #2980b9;\\\">Data</span></a><span style=\\\"color: #2980b9;\\\"> </span></u></li></ul>\\n</li><li><u><a href=\\\"#FAQ\\\"><span style=\\\"color: #2980b9;\\\">Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)</span></a></u></li></ul>\\n<p data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\">&nbsp;</p>\\n<h2 data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\"><strong><span style=\\\"font-size: 22px;\\\"><a name=\\\"requirements\\\" id=\\\"requirements\\\"><span style=\\\"color: #00214d;\\\">What is the Electronic Health Information Export Requirement?</span></a></span></strong></h2>\\n<p data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\">The 21st Century CURES updates to 2015 Certified EHR Technology (CEHRT) update requires criteria § 170.315 (b)(10) Electronic Health Information Export to be met in 2023 by Health IT. The requirement states that all certified Health IT must be able to export Electronic Health Information (including payment data, imaging, and any data stored in the module at time of export) for both a single patient, as requested by the patient, and the patient population, as requested by the provider.&nbsp;<br><br>To fulfill this requirement for both the single patient and patient population exports, the data must be exported electronically and in a computable format by Elation within a reasonable request of time. This Help Center Article will act as the publicly accessible hyperlink of the export’s format that must be included in the export file as outlined by the criteria.<br><br><br>&nbsp;</p>\\n<h2 data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\"><a name=\\\"compliance\\\" id=\\\"compliance\\\"><strong><span style=\\\"color: #00214d;\\\"><span style=\\\"font-size: 22px;\\\">How Elation will help you stay compliant</span></span></strong></a></h2>\\n<p data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\">To export EHI data for a single patient:</p>\\n<ol data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\"><li>Open the patient’s chart in Elation.</li><li>Click the “More” button in the navigation bar and then click “Data Exchange”.</li><li>Click “Export Entire Health Information (EHI)” .</li><li>Afterwards click “Export Patient EHI” in the confirmation box.</li><li>You will receive two emails at the email listed in the confirmation box. The emails will have the subject line ‘<em>ACTION REQUIRED: Elation Data Export’</em>. One email will contain a download link for the export and the other email will contain the password to unlock the file after you download it. You will have 6 days to download the file before the download link expires.\\n<ul style=\\\"list-style-type: disc;\\\"><li>You can optionally choose to email a copy of the export to the patient by checking off the “Also share with patient” box. We recommend verifying the patient’s email address before sending them the export.</li></ul>\\n</li></ol>\\n<p data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\">&nbsp;</p>\\n<div style=\\\"background-color: #fff9f2;\\\" data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\"><span style=\\\"color: #fb9d83;\\\"><b>Important Note</b></span>:&nbsp;In order to export EHI for individual patients, you must have Admin level privileges.&nbsp;To become an Admin, you must ask&nbsp;an existing Admin level user in&nbsp;your practice (most likely a primary provider level account holder) to grant you privileges via the&nbsp;<u><a target=\\\"_blank\\\" href=\\\"https://help.elationhealth.com/s/article/managing-user-accounts\\\" data-lightning-target=\\\"_blank\\\"><span style=\\\"color: #2980b9;\\\">Manage Accounts</span></a></u>&nbsp;Settings page.</div>\\n<p data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\"><br><br>Providers can also request that Elation completes an EHI export for their entire patient panel at their request. For additional support regarding Electronic Health Information Exports, including expedited exports and customized exports which may include a cost for customized reports, <u><a target=\\\"_blank\\\" href=\\\"https://help.elationemr.com/s/contactsupport\\\"><span style=\\\"color: #2980b9;\\\">please submit a request here</span></a></u>.&nbsp;<br><br>Integrators with Elation can reach out to Elation&nbsp;for EHI export requests using <span style=\\\"text-decoration: underline;\\\"><span style=\\\"color: #2980b9;text-decoration: underline;\\\"><a style=\\\"color: #2980b9;text-decoration: underline;\\\" target=\\\"_blank\\\" href=\\\"https://help.elationhealth.com/s/contactsupport\\\">this Contact Support form</a></span></span>.<br><br>&nbsp;</p>\\n<h2 data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\"><strong><span style=\\\"font-size: 22px;\\\"><a name=\\\"additional_regulatory_info\\\" id=\\\"additional_regulatory_info\\\"><span style=\\\"color: #00214d;\\\">Additional Regulatory Information</span></a></span></strong></h2>\\n<p data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\">Elation Health facilitates Customers’ ability to comply with information disclosure obligations in its exporting of electronic patient health information. It is the Customer’s responsibility to understand applicable laws, rules and regulations applicable to its practice and to comply. &nbsp;By default, the Elation Health EHI does not include information identified as “Confidential Notes” (defined below) in exports. &nbsp;It is Customer’s responsibility to ensure that psychotherapy notes as defined in 45 CFR 164.501, information compiled in reasonable anticipation of, or for use in, a civil, criminal, or administrative action or proceeding, or data regarding a person who has been deceased for more than 50 years or other information that may not subject to disclosure are included in these Confidential Notes areas of the EHI. In accordance to the EHI Export certification criterion, all electronic patient information will be exported, except for the following subsets of data:<br><br>Confidential Notes Features:&nbsp;</p>\\n<ul style=\\\"list-style-type: circle;\\\" data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\"><li>Files in Elation that can be tagged as ‘Keep this Confidential’ (e.g., orders and visit notes) or ‘Mark Confidential’ (e.g., reports)</li><li>Free text in the ‘Notes and Chart Management’ section in the Demographic Dialog</li><li>Free text in the ‘Notes’ section of our Elation Billing product</li></ul>\\n<p data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\"><br>For single patient exports requested by the patient, Confidential Notes will always be withheld.* For bulk exports requested by a provider or practice, users will have the option to include or exclude Confidential Notes.<br><br>*Additional information: In alignment with the HIPAA Privacy Rule, it is the provider’s responsibility to include any information that would otherwise be disclosable to a patient under applicable state and federal healthcare laws. For single export requests by a patient where the Confidential Notes are requested, <u><a target=\\\"_blank\\\" href=\\\"https://help.elationemr.com/s/contactsupport\\\"><span style=\\\"color: #2980b9;\\\">please reach out to Elation Support</span></a></u> to fulfill this request.&nbsp;Confidential Notes features are intended to help providers restrict access to information that qualifies for an information blocking exception under applicable law; however it is the provider’s responsibility to ensure its compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations related to information disclosure.<br><br>&nbsp;</p>\\n<h2 data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\"><strong><span style=\\\"font-size: 22px;\\\"><a name=\\\"designated_record_set\\\" id=\\\"designated_record_set\\\"><span style=\\\"color: #00214d;\\\">Elation’s Designated Record Set</span></a><span style=\\\"color: #00214d;\\\"> </span></span></strong></h2>\\n<p data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\">In accordance with the Electronic Health Information Export criteria, Elation must provide information about the export format to facilitate the interpretation of the electronic health information. The Elation Health Designated Record Set contains the electronic health information available in a patient's Elation Health record in a computable, pdf, xml, or image file format. Some electronic health information might not be available in an xml or pdf format, such as rich text documents or images. This information might be referenced from the EHI Tables, but the actual files can be reviewed in a separate download in the export. Information may not be available based on the configuration of modules from Elation Health the practice, provider, or integrations in use.&nbsp;<br><br>The content included in the export might vary based on a variety of factors, including:</p>\\n<ul style=\\\"list-style-type: circle;\\\" data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\"><li>The software applications in use at the practice or provider that generated the files.</li><li>The documentation and software use practices in place at the practice or provider &nbsp;that generated the files.</li><li>Configuration decisions made by the practice or provider that generated the files.</li><li>The practice or provider includes materials not sourced from Elation Health.</li></ul>\\n<p data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\">&nbsp;</p>\\n<h3 data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\"><strong><a name=\\\"data\\\" id=\\\"data\\\"><span style=\\\"color: #00214d;\\\"><span style=\\\"font-size: 18px;\\\">Data</span></span></a></strong></h3>\\n<p data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\">The data elements listed in Elation's Designated Record Set are the identified data elements in Elation’s system which store EHI. The formats of data exported are associated with the relative datum.<br><br><u><a target=\\\"_blank\\\" href=\\\"https://elation.my.salesforce.com/sfc/p/37000000L9cg/a/Ui000000gb9d/iZNUvfk2RrsubsEDBM18Eyr.QSjIklWlK.afMI1bG24\\\"><span style=\\\"color: #2980b9;\\\">Click here to download a copy of Elation's Data Resource Table and its export formats</span></a></u>.<br><br><br>&nbsp;</p>\\n<h2 data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\"><strong><span style=\\\"font-size: 22px;\\\"><a name=\\\"FAQ\\\" id=\\\"FAQ\\\"><span style=\\\"color: #00214d;\\\">Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)</span></a><span style=\\\"color: #00214d;\\\"> </span></span></strong></h2>\\n<h4 data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\"><span style=\\\"font-size: 14px;\\\"><strong><span style=\\\"color: #4e5f70;\\\">My practice has multiple instances on Elation. Will I receive a separate export for each instance?</span></strong></span></h4>\\n<p data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\">At this time, Elation does not support cohorting or filtering of patient data to fulfill this requirement. The § 170.315 (b)(10) Electronic Health Information Export criteria states that filtering and the ability to create subsets are not required for certification.<br>&nbsp;</p>\\n<h4 data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\"><strong><span style=\\\"color: #4e5f70;\\\"><span style=\\\"font-size: 14px;\\\">How do I export data for a single patient?</span></span></strong></h4>\\n<p data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\">To export EHI data for a single patient:</p>\\n<ol data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\"><li>Open the patient’s chart in Elation.</li><li>Click the “More” button in the navigation bar and then click “Data Exchange”.</li><li>Click “Export Entire Health Information (EHI)” .</li><li>Afterwards click “Export Patient EHI” in the confirmation box.</li><li>You will receive two emails at the email listed in the confirmation box. The emails will have the subject line <em>‘ACTION REQUIRED: Elation Data Export’</em>. One email will contain a download link for the export and the other email will contain the password to unlock the file after you download it. You will have 6 days to download the file before the download link expires.\\n<ul style=\\\"list-style-type: disc;\\\"><li>You can optionally choose to email a copy of the export to the patient by checking off the “Also share with patient” box. data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\"><span style=\\\"font-size: 22px;\\\"><strong><span style=\\\"color: #00214d;\\\">Contents</span></strong></span></h2>\\n<ul style=\\\"list-style-type: href=\\\"#data\\\"><span style=\\\"color: #2980b9;\\\">Data</span></a><span style=\\\"color: #2980b9;\\\"> </span></u></li></ul>\\n</li><li><u><a href=\\\"#FAQ\\\"><span style=\\\"color: #2980b9;\\\">Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)</span></a></u></li></ul>\\n<p data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\">&nbsp;</p>\\n<h2 data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\"><strong><span style=\\\"font-size: 22px;\\\"><a name=\\\"requirements\\\" id=\\\"requirements\\\"><span style=\\\"color: #00214d;\\\">What is the Electronic Health Information Export Requirement?</span></a></span></strong></h2>\\n<p data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\">The 21st Century CURES updates to 2015 Certified EHR Technology (CEHRT) update requires criteria § 170.315 (b)(10) Electronic Health Information Export to be met in 2023 by Health IT. The requirement states that all certified Health IT must be able to export Electronic Health Information (including payment data, imaging, and any data stored in the module at time of export) for both a single patient, as requested by the patient, and the patient population, as requested by the provider.&nbsp;<br><br>To fulfill this requirement for both the single patient and patient population exports, the data must be exported electronically and in a computable format by Elation within a reasonable request of time. This Help Center Article will act as the publicly accessible hyperlink of the export’s format that must be included in the export file as outlined by the criteria.<br><br><br>&nbsp;</p>\\n<h2 data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\"><a name=\\\"compliance\\\" id=\\\"compliance\\\"><strong><span style=\\\"color: #00214d;\\\"><span style=\\\"font-size: 22px;\\\">How Elation will help you stay compliant</span></span></strong></a></h2>\\n<p data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\">To export EHI data for a single patient:</p>\\n<ol data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\"><li>Open the patient’s chart in Elation.</li><li>Click the “More” button in the navigation bar and then click “Data Exchange”.</li><li>Click “Export Entire Health Information (EHI)” .</li><li>Afterwards click “Export Patient EHI” in the confirmation box.</li><li>You will receive two emails at the email listed in the confirmation box. The emails will have the subject line ‘<em>ACTION REQUIRED: Elation Data Export’</em>. One email will contain a download link for the export and the other email will contain the password to unlock the file after you download it. You will have 6 days to download the file before the download link expires.\\n<ul style=\\\"list-style-type: disc;\\\"><li>You can optionally choose to email a copy of the export to the patient by checking off the “Also share with patient” box. We recommend verifying the patient’s email address before sending them the export.</li></ul>\\n</li></ol>\\n<p data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\">&nbsp;</p>\\n<div style=\\\"background-color: #fff9f2;\\\" data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\"><span style=\\\"color: #fb9d83;\\\"><b>Important Note</b></span>:&nbsp;In order to export EHI for individual patients, you must have Admin level privileges.&nbsp;To become an Admin, you must ask&nbsp;an existing Admin level user in&nbsp;your practice (most likely a primary provider level account holder) to grant you privileges via the&nbsp;<u><a target=\\\"_blank\\\" href=\\\"https://help.elationhealth.com/s/article/managing-user-accounts\\\" data-lightning-target=\\\"_blank\\\"><span style=\\\"color: #2980b9;\\\">Manage Accounts</span></a></u>&nbsp;Settings page.</div>\\n<p data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\"><br><br>Providers can also request that Elation completes an EHI export for their entire patient panel at their request. For additional support regarding Electronic Health Information Exports, including expedited exports and customized exports which may include a cost for customized reports, <u><a target=\\\"_blank\\\" href=\\\"https://help.elationemr.com/s/contactsupport\\\"><span style=\\\"color: #2980b9;\\\">please submit a request here</span></a></u>.&nbsp;<br><br>Integrators with Elation can reach out to Elation&nbsp;for EHI export requests using <span style=\\\"text-decoration: underline;\\\"><span style=\\\"color: #2980b9;text-decoration: underline;\\\"><a style=\\\"color: #2980b9;text-decoration: underline;\\\" target=\\\"_blank\\\" href=\\\"https://help.elationhealth.com/s/contactsupport\\\">this Contact Support form</a></span></span>.<br><br>&nbsp;</p>\\n<h2 data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\"><strong><span style=\\\"font-size: 22px;\\\"><a name=\\\"additional_regulatory_info\\\" id=\\\"additional_regulatory_info\\\"><span style=\\\"color: #00214d;\\\">Additional Regulatory Information</span></a></span></strong></h2>\\n<p data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\">Elation Health facilitates Customers’ ability to comply with information disclosure obligations in its exporting of electronic patient health information. It is the Customer’s responsibility to understand applicable laws, rules and regulations applicable to its practice and to comply. &nbsp;By default, the Elation Health EHI does not include information identified as “Confidential Notes” (defined below) in exports. &nbsp;It is Customer’s responsibility to ensure that psychotherapy notes as defined in 45 CFR 164.501, information compiled in reasonable anticipation of, or for use in, a civil, criminal, or administrative action or proceeding, or data regarding a person who has been deceased for more than 50 years or other information that may not subject to disclosure are included in these Confidential Notes areas of the EHI. In accordance to the EHI Export certification criterion, all electronic patient information will be exported, except for the following subsets of data:<br><br>Confidential Notes Features:&nbsp;</p>\\n<ul style=\\\"list-style-type: circle;\\\" data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\"><li>Files in Elation that can be tagged as ‘Keep this Confidential’ (e.g., orders and visit notes) or ‘Mark Confidential’ (e.g., reports)</li><li>Free text in the ‘Notes and Chart Management’ section in the Demographic Dialog</li><li>Free text in the ‘Notes’ section of our Elation Billing product</li></ul>\\n<p data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\"><br>For single patient exports requested by the patient, Confidential Notes will always be withheld.* For bulk exports requested by a provider or practice, users will have the option to include or exclude Confidential Notes.<br><br>*Additional information: In alignment with the HIPAA Privacy Rule, it is the provider’s responsibility to include any information that would otherwise be disclosable to a patient under applicable state and federal healthcare laws. For single export requests by a patient where the Confidential Notes are requested, <u><a target=\\\"_blank\\\" href=\\\"https://help.elationemr.com/s/contactsupport\\\"><span style=\\\"color: #2980b9;\\\">please reach out to Elation Support</span></a></u> to fulfill this request.&nbsp;Confidential Notes features are intended to help providers restrict access to information that qualifies for an information blocking exception under applicable law; however it is the provider’s responsibility to ensure its compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations related to information disclosure.<br><br>&nbsp;</p>\\n<h2 data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\"><strong><span style=\\\"font-size: 22px;\\\"><a name=\\\"designated_record_set\\\" id=\\\"designated_record_set\\\"><span style=\\\"color: #00214d;\\\">Elation’s Designated Record Set</span></a><span style=\\\"color: #00214d;\\\"> </span></span></strong></h2>\\n<p data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\">In accordance with the Electronic Health Information Export criteria, Elation must provide information about the export format to facilitate the interpretation of the electronic health information. The Elation Health Designated Record Set contains the electronic health information available in a patient's Elation Health record in a computable, pdf, xml, or image file format. Some electronic health information might not be available in an xml or pdf format, such as rich text documents or images. This information might be referenced from the EHI Tables, but the actual files can be reviewed in a separate download in the export. Information may not be available based on the configuration of modules from Elation Health the practice, provider, or integrations in use.&nbsp;<br><br>The content included in the export might vary based on a variety of factors, including:</p>\\n<ul style=\\\"list-style-type: circle;\\\" data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\"><li>The software applications in use at the practice or provider that generated the files.</li><li>The documentation and software use practices in place at the practice or provider &nbsp;that generated the files.</li><li>Configuration decisions made by the practice or provider that generated the files.</li><li>The practice or provider includes materials not sourced from Elation Health.</li></ul>\\n<p data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\">&nbsp;</p>\\n<h3 data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\"><strong><a name=\\\"data\\\" id=\\\"data\\\"><span style=\\\"color: #00214d;\\\"><span style=\\\"font-size: 18px;\\\">Data</span></span></a></strong></h3>\\n<p data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\">The data elements listed in Elation's Designated Record Set are the identified data elements in Elation’s system which store EHI. The formats of data exported are associated with the relative datum.<br><br><u><a target=\\\"_blank\\\" href=\\\"https://elation.my.salesforce.com/sfc/p/37000000L9cg/a/Ui000000gb9d/iZNUvfk2RrsubsEDBM18Eyr.QSjIklWlK.afMI1bG24\\\"><span style=\\\"color: #2980b9;\\\">Click here to download a copy of Elation's Data Resource Table and its export formats</span></a></u>.<br><br><br>&nbsp;</p>\\n<h2 data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\"><strong><span style=\\\"font-size: 22px;\\\"><a name=\\\"FAQ\\\" id=\\\"FAQ\\\"><span style=\\\"color: #00214d;\\\">Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)</span></a><span style=\\\"color: #00214d;\\\"> </span></span></strong></h2>\\n<h4 data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\"><span style=\\\"font-size: 14px;\\\"><strong><span style=\\\"color: #4e5f70;\\\">My practice has multiple instances on Elation. Will I receive a separate export for each instance?</span></strong></span></h4>\\n<p data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\">At this time, Elation does not support cohorting or filtering of patient data to fulfill this requirement. The § 170.315 (b)(10) Electronic Health Information Export criteria states that filtering and the ability to create subsets are not required for certification.<br>&nbsp;</p>\\n<h4 data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\"><strong><span style=\\\"color: #4e5f70;\\\"><span style=\\\"font-size: 14px;\\\">How do I export data for a single patient?</span></span></strong></h4>\\n<p data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\">To export EHI data for a single patient:</p>\\n<ol data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\"><li>Open the patient’s chart in Elation.</li><li>Click the “More” button in the navigation bar and then click “Data Exchange”.</li><li>Click “Export Entire Health Information (EHI)” .</li><li>Afterwards click “Export Patient EHI” in the confirmation box.</li><li>You will receive two emails at the email listed in the confirmation box. The emails will have the subject line <em>‘ACTION REQUIRED: Elation Data Export’</em>. One email will contain a download link for the export and the other email will contain the password to unlock the file after you download it. You will have 6 days to download the file before the download link expires.\\n<ul style=\\\"list-style-type: disc;\\\"><li>You can optionally choose to email a copy of the export to the patient by checking off the “Also share with patient” box. We recommend verifying the patient’s email address before sending them the export.</li></ul>\\n</li></ol>\\n<p data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\">&nbsp;</p>\\n<h4 data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\"><br><span style=\\\"font-size: 14px;\\\"><strong><span style=\\\"color: #4e5f70;\\\">How do I export EHI data for my entire practice?</span></strong></span></h4>\\n<p data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\">Providers can also request that Elation completes an EHI export for their entire patient panel at their request. For additional support regarding Electronic Health Information Exports, including expedited exports and customized exports which may include a cost for customized reports, <u><a target=\\\"_blank\\\" href=\\\"https://help.elationemr.com/s/contactsupport\\\"><span style=\\\"color: #2980b9;\\\">please submit a request here</span></a></u>.&nbsp;<br><br>Integrators with Elation can reach out to Elation&nbsp;for EHI export requests using <span style=\\\"color: #2980b9;text-decoration: underline;\\\"><a style=\\\"color: #2980b9;text-decoration: underline;\\\" target=\\\"_blank\\\" href=\\\"https://help.elationhealth.com/s/contactsupport\\\">this Contact Support form</a></span>.<br><br>&nbsp;</p>\\n<h4 data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\"><span style=\\\"color: #4e5f70;\\\"><span style=\\\"font-size: 14px;\\\"><strong>How do I export the data for all patients assigned to a specific Provider?</strong></span></span></h4>\\n<p data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\">Providers can also request that Elation completes an EHI export for their entire patient panel at their request. It is the Customer’s responsibility to understand applicable laws, rules and regulations applicable to its practice and to comply. &nbsp;By default, the Elation Health EHI does not include information identified as “Confidential Notes” (defined below) in exports. &nbsp;It is Customer’s responsibility to ensure that psychotherapy notes as defined in 45 CFR 164.501, information compiled in reasonable anticipation of, or for use in, a civil, criminal, or administrative action or proceeding, or data regarding a person who has been deceased for more than 50 years or other information that may not subject to disclosure are included in these Confidential Notes areas of the EHI. In accordance to the EHI Export certification criterion, all electronic patient information will be exported, except for the following subsets of data:<br><br>Confidential Notes Features:&nbsp;</p>\\n<ul style=\\\"list-style-type: circle;\\\" data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\"><li>Files in Elation that can be tagged as ‘Keep this Confidential’ (e.g., orders and visit notes) or ‘Mark Confidential’ (e.g., reports)</li><li>Free text in the ‘Notes and Chart Management’ section in the Demographic Dialog</li><li>Free text in the ‘Notes’ section of our Elation Billing product</li></ul>\\n<p data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\"><br>For single patient exports requested by the patient, Confidential Notes will always be withheld.* For bulk exports requested by a provider or practice, users will have the option to include or exclude Confidential Notes.<br><br>*Additional information: In alignment with the HIPAA Privacy Rule, it is the provider’s responsibility to include any information that would otherwise be disclosable to a patient under applicable state and federal healthcare laws. For single export requests by a patient where the Confidential Notes are requested, <u><a target=\\\"_blank\\\" href=\\\"https://help.elationemr.com/s/contactsupport\\\"><span style=\\\"color: #2980b9;\\\">please reach out to Elation Support</span></a></u> to fulfill this request.&nbsp;Confidential Notes features are intended to help providers restrict access to information that qualifies for an information blocking exception under applicable law; however it is the provider’s responsibility to ensure its compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations related to information disclosure.<br><br>&nbsp;</p>\\n<h2 data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\"><strong><span style=\\\"font-size: 22px;\\\"><a name=\\\"designated_record_set\\\" id=\\\"designated_record_set\\\"><span style=\\\"color: #00214d;\\\">Elation’s Designated Record Set</span></a><span style=\\\"color: #00214d;\\\"> </span></span></strong></h2>\\n<p data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\">In accordance with the Electronic Health Information Export criteria, Elation must provide information about the export format to facilitate the interpretation of the electronic health information. The Elation Health Designated Record Set contains the electronic health information available in a patient's Elation Health record in a computable, pdf, xml, or image file format. Some electronic health information might not be available in an xml or pdf format, such as rich text documents or images. This information might be referenced from the EHI Tables, but the actual files can be reviewed in a separate download in the export. Information may not be available based on the configuration of modules from Elation Health the practice, provider, or integrations in use.&nbsp;<br><br>The content included in the export might vary based on a variety of factors, including:</p>\\n<ul style=\\\"list-style-type: circle;\\\" data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\"><li>The software applications in use at the practice or provider that generated the files.</li><li>The documentation and software use practices in place at the practice or provider &nbsp;that generated the files.</li><li>Configuration decisions made by the practice or provider that generated the files.</li><li>The practice or provider includes materials not sourced from Elation Health.</li></ul>\\n<p data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\">&nbsp;</p>\\n<h3 data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\"><strong><a name=\\\"data\\\" id=\\\"data\\\"><span style=\\\"color: #00214d;\\\"><span style=\\\"font-size: 18px;\\\">Data</span></span></a></strong></h3>\\n<p data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\">The data elements listed in Elation's Designated Record Set are the identified data elements in Elation’s system which store EHI. Will I receive a separate export for each instance?</span></strong></span></h4>\\n<p data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\">At this time, Elation does not support cohorting or filtering of patient data to fulfill this requirement. The § 170.315 (b)(10) Electronic Health Information Export criteria states that filtering and the ability to create subsets are not required for certification.<br>&nbsp;</p>\\n<h4 data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\"><strong><span style=\\\"color: #4e5f70;\\\"><span style=\\\"font-size: 14px;\\\">How do I export data for a single patient?</span></span></strong></h4>\\n<p data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\">To export EHI data for a single patient:</p>\\n<ol data-aura-rendered-by=\\\"33:228;a\\\"><li>Open the patient’s chart in Elation.</li><li>Click the “More” button in the navigation bar and then click “Data Exchange”.</li><li>Click “Export Entire Health Information (EHI)” .</li><li>Afterwards click “Export Patient EHI” in the confirmation box.</li><li>You will receive two emails at the email listed in the confirmation box. You will have 6 days to download the file before the download link expires.\\n<ul style=\\\"list-style-type: disc;\\\"><li>You can optionally choose to email a copy of the export to the patient by checking off the “Also share with patient” box. It is the Customer’s responsibility to understand applicable laws, rules and regulations applicable to its practice and to comply. &nbsp;By default, the Elation Health EHI does not include information identified as “Confidential Notes” (defined below) in exports. &nbsp;It is Customer’s responsibility to ensure that psychotherapy notes as defined in 45 CFR 164.501, information compiled in reasonable anticipation of, or for use in, a civil, criminal, or administrative action or proceeding, or data regarding a person who has been deceased for more than 50 years or other information that may not subject to disclosure are included in these Confidential Notes areas of the EHI. The documentation is genuinely focused on the (b)(10) EHI export requirement — it explicitly references § 170.315 (b)(10), discusses the designated record set, and describes a purpose-built export mechanism rather than repackaging a FHIR API.\n\n### Export Mechanism\n\n**Single patient export**: Available directly in the Elation EMR UI. Users navigate to a patient's chart → More → Data Exchange → \"Export Entire Health Information (EHI)\" → \"Export Patient EHI\". The export is delivered via two emails: one with a download link (valid 6 days) and one with the password to decrypt the file. Admin-level privileges are required.\n\n**Bulk/population export**: Practices must contact Elation support to request a population-level export. The documentation notes that \"expedited exports and customized exports may include a cost for customized reports.\" No self-service bulk export UI is described.\n\n### Export Format\n\nThe export uses **multiple formats** depending on the data type:\n- **Computable PDF**: Used for clinical data — demographics, medications, clinical records, problem lists, vitals, allergies, visit notes, lab results, referrals, letters, imaging reports\n- **XML**: Used for some clinical data alongside PDF — problem lists, procedures, vitals, allergies, and some medications share XML export\n- **JSON**: Used exclusively for billing and eligibility data — bills, CPT codes, patient liabilities, payment charges, payment requests, eligibility/insurance verification\n- **CSV**: Used for appointments, demographics, guarantor information, insurance details, and some clinical data\n\nThis is a proprietary, multi-format export — not FHIR, not C-CDA, not a database dump. Different data domains are exported in whichever format Elation has implemented for that domain. The documentation explicitly states that some information \"might not be available in an xml or pdf format, such as rich text documents or images\" and that \"actual files can be reviewed in a separate download in the export.\"\n\n### Data Dictionary (PDF)\n\nThe \"Designated Record Set for EHI Export\" PDF (dated 2/6/2024) contains a 7-page table with 4 columns:\n- **Data Element** (field name)\n- **Data Description** (brief description)\n- **Export format indicators**: Computable PDF Export, XML Export, JSON, CSV Export\n\nThe enrichment pipeline extracted 199 data elements across these sections:\n\n| Section | Count | Primary Format |\n|---------|-------|---------------|\n| Patient Demographics | 57 | Computable PDF, CSV |\n| Billing - Bills | 53 | JSON |\n| Billing - Patient Liability | 26 | JSON |\n| Eligibility/Insurance Verification | 14 | JSON |\n| Clinical Records | 9 | Computable PDF, XML |\n| Guarantor Information | 9 | CSV |\n| Billing - Payment Requests | 9 | JSON |\n| Appointments | 6 | CSV |\n| Medications | 5 | Computable PDF |\n| Care Team & Documents | 3 | Computable PDF (XML in the data) |\n| Additional Demographics | 2 | CSV |\n| Imaging | 1 | Computable PDF |\n| Patient Status | 1 | CSV |\n| Social History | 1 | Computable PDF |\n| Clinical Orders | 1 | Computable PDF, JSON |\n\n### Confidential Notes Exclusion\n\nElation has a \"Confidential Notes\" mechanism that excludes certain data by default:\n- Files tagged as \"Keep this Confidential\" (orders, visit notes) or \"Mark Confidential\" (reports)\n- Free text in the \"Notes and Chart Management\" section of the Demographic Dialog\n- Free text in the \"Notes\" section of Elation Billing\n\nFor patient-requested exports, Confidential Notes are always withheld. For provider-requested bulk exports, users can choose to include or exclude them. This is appropriately scoped to the psychotherapy notes and litigation compilation carve-outs in EHI.\n\n## Export Coverage Assessment\n\n### Data Domain Coverage\n\n**Clearly covered domains:**\n- Patient demographics (extensive — 57+ fields including name, DOB, gender, race, ethnicity, address, contact info, insurance, emergency contacts, preferred pharmacy, language, marital status, sexual orientation)\n- Billing (highly detailed — bills with CPT codes, modifiers, ICD-10/ICD-9 diagnosis codes, charges, payments; patient liabilities with payment processing details; eligibility verification with plan details, copay, coinsurance, deductible)\n- Medications (current, OTC, temporary, discontinued, permanent Rx)\n- Clinical records (problem list, procedures, vitals, allergies, visit notes, lab results, referrals, letters, medical history report)\n- Immunization history\n- Imaging reports\n- Clinical orders (lab, imaging, pulmonary, cardiac, sleep orders)\n- Social history and substance use\n- Care team (providers list)\n- Patient-uploaded files and documents\n- Messages between patient and provider\n- Appointment data (type, date/time, status, description, provider, duration)\n- Guarantor information for billing\n\n**Domains with potential gaps or ambiguity:**\n- **ePrescribing details**: Medications are listed, but the data dictionary doesn't explicitly include prescription routing data, pharmacy responses, EPCS records, or Surescripts transaction details. This is acceptable for (b)(10) since no specific format is mandated, but it creates significant challenges for data portability:\n\n- **No unified schema**: The export mixes PDF, XML, JSON, and CSV with no documented schema for any of them. The PDF data dictionary lists field names but provides no XML/JSON schemas, XSDs, or sample files.\n- **Format inconsistency**: The same type of clinical data is exported differently — vitals get PDF+XML, visit notes get only PDF, billing gets JSON. There's no obvious rationale for which format is used where.\n- **No relational structure**: The data dictionary is a flat list of fields without table/entity groupings, foreign key relationships, or cardinality. A field like \"Patient ID\" appears multiple times across different conceptual entities but there's no explicit schema linking bills to patients to encounters.\n- **Import difficulty**: A receiving system would have significant difficulty reconstructing the patient record from this export without extensive reverse-engineering of the file formats.\n\nThis is **not** a (g)(10) FHIR repackaging — it's a genuine custom export. However, the lack of machine-readable schemas (JSON Schema, XSD, OpenAPI) makes it much harder to use programmatically than a standard-based export would be.\n\n### Documentation Quality\n\n**Strengths:**\n- The documentation explicitly addresses (b)(10) by name and correctly describes the designated record set concept\n- The data dictionary covers 199 data elements across clinical, demographic, and billing domains\n- The Confidential Notes exclusion mechanism is thoughtfully documented\n- Export instructions are clear and step-by-step for single-patient exports\n- The article is publicly accessible (no login required) as required\n\n**Weaknesses:**\n- **No sample export files**: There are no example exports showing what the actual output looks like — no sample CSV, JSON, XML, or PDF files\n- **No format specifications**: The data dictionary says which *format* each element uses but provides zero detail about the format structure (JSON schema?
